rationale: Price is sitting at 8.6% of today's range, just 0.24% above the session low, with the last five 1-minute candles showing near-zero movement and very low volume — indicating a stalled, directionless tape rather than a clean setup in either direction. The stock gapped up and has since sold off from the $25.57 high toward the low end of range, but there is no clear momentum signal or structure break to enter short, and the proximity to the low without a bounce attempt makes a long entry low-conviction. With SPY down 1.35% and VIXY elevated, the broad environment adds noise; the risk/reward for either direction is insufficient to commit capital here.
